name: lazy-stoner-donator-social-assets

preserve: dark shirt with playful patch energy

creative_direction.summary: Create a sympathetic Lazy Stoner Donator social-sharing hero image and icon set from the existing comic portrait reference.
creative_direction.character: A stereotypical but affectionate Cannachris character: tired eyes, soft sleepy expression, very warm gaze, slightly drooling in a harmless cartoon way, one hand stretched forward in a gentle begging gesture, friendly and funny rather than desperate.
creative_direction.mood: heartfelt, lazy, tired, generous, slightly absurd, human, approachable, activist-friendly
creative_direction.visual_style: clean high-resolution illustrated comic artwork, crisp outlines, warm skin tones, soft green cannabis-campaign accents, modern editorial social-media composition, no photorealism
creative_direction.composition: Center the character with enough safe space around head and hand for social-media cropping. Keep the face readable at small sizes. Use a soft green and off-white background with subtle wishlist/gift motifs.
creative_direction.text_policy: Do not render text inside the image except if explicitly requested for a later variant. Leave text overlays to HTML/social platform metadata.

required_outputs.purpose: Open Graph, LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp, Telegram
required_outputs.safe_area: Keep the face, extended hand, and main gesture inside the central 1000x520 area.

required_outputs.purpose: Square social preview and fallback image
required_outputs.safe_area: Keep the full head and extended hand inside the central 900x900 area.

required_outputs.purpose: High-resolution transparent source for favicon and app icons
required_outputs.safe_area: Head and shoulders only, transparent background, strong silhouette.

required_outputs.purpose: Source icon for generated favicon sizes
required_outputs.safe_area: Head only, bold outline, readable at 32x32.

negative_prompt: do not make the character look sick, frightening, intoxicated, aggressive, humiliated, dirty, or exploitative
no realistic saliva strings; keep drool as a tiny harmless cartoon detail
no needles, drugs, smoke clouds, bongs, or illegal-consumption imagery
no unreadable text, no watermark, no pseudo-signature
no AI-glitch artifacts, extra fingers, broken hands, distorted eyes, cropped face, or missing hand

seo_context.meta_description: Unterstütze Cannachris mit nützlichen Wunschgeschenken, kleinen Gesten und konkreten Ideen für Content, Aktivismus, Alltag und Community.
seo_context.share_message: Ein müder, herzlicher Cannachris bittet charmant um Support: Wunsch aussuchen, teilen oder eine gute Tat schenken.

quality_checks: face remains recognizable from the reference image
expression is tired but warm, not miserable
begging gesture is friendly and humorous
landscape crop works for Open Graph
square crop works for social feeds
head crop remains readable as favicon
